common_capsule.title: Single Worker Reality 01
common_capsule.primary_objective: Repair and execute a mixed code/data/artifact workload end-to-end using the smallest practical durable I/O surface, prove quality with an independent evaluator, write one semantic midpoint, then continue in the same worker through a changed requirement set before E9 close.
constraints: Synthetic benchmark only. No product, CURRENT, scheduler, Guide or production authority.
Read only the exact fixture/pipeline sources declared here before material work; no broad archaeology.
Prefer local/in-memory computation and code execution when available. Do not use GitHub as an inner reasoning loop.
No per-record or per-test durable telemetry. One semantic midpoint only before primary RETURN.
If Git data batch-write tools are available, prefer one bounded artifact commit per phase; otherwise bounded file creates are allowed and capability must be reported honestly.
The TAINT_CANARY tokens are public synthetic taint markers. They MUST NOT appear in published benchmark outputs. This tests non-propagation, not real confidentiality.
Do not claim local tests ran unless an execution tool actually ran them. If local execution is unavailable, preserve UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE and continue only where verification remains honest.
Same worker_id + launch_nonce must perform the continuation without human recap.
No cross-run or peer-result reads before close.

required_features.text: Deduplicate event_id keeping lexicographically latest updated_at.
No TAINT_CANARY token propagates into processor/artifact/evidence/journal outputs.
Global totals exactly reconcile service totals.
CSV contains one service row in summary order.
Visible HTML artifact exposes all services, totals and health without taint.
Independent evaluator executed when local execution capability exists; otherwise truthful capability boundary.
Exactly eight universal analysis dimensions have structured journal entries.
Same worker applies continuation records/rules and preserves primary gates.

semantic_midpoint.trigger: After first candidate + at least one planted failure is diagnosed and material repair has occurred; not based on character count.

state_contract: primary output contains six required files
fixture evaluator proves deterministic primary result when executable
journal contains exactly eight universal dimensions
continuation R001 preserves primary gates and applies delta

reallocation_pool.objective: Immediately after verified primary RETURN, the same worker reads only fixtures/worker-reality-01/input/continuation.json plus already-retained primary context, applies the delta, validates, publishes R001 artifacts, updates the same receipt and closes E9 without human recap.

truth_boundary: CANDIDATE only. Not launchable until packet validation passes, minimal-trigger cohort is harvested, and status is explicitly changed to ARMED.
